rival.beyondsolo.notify.title: Rival party · %s
rival.beyondsolo.notify.dispatched.title: A rival party sets out · %s
rival.beyondsolo.notify.dispatched.body: %s set out for a rank %s gate %s blocks to the %s. They'll be there in about %s: get in first and the gate is yours.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.arrived: %s reached the gate. They go in in %s.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.stood_down.too_l: %s turned back: the gate was already cleared.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.stood_down.claim: %s turned back: the Association gave that gate to another hunter.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.stood_down.beate: %s got to the gate after you and turned back. It's yours.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.went_in.race: %s went into the rank %s gate after you. Race them to the boss: whoever deals it the most damage takes its reward.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.went_in.holds: %s went into the rank %s gate first, so it's theirs to clear. Going in after them costs merit.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.following: %s won't give the gate up: they're coming in after you. Race them to the boss: whoever deals it the most damage takes its reward.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.beaten: A hunter got to the boss of the rank %2$s gate before %1$s did.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.retreated.beaten: %s was beaten back out of the rank %s gate. It's open to anyone again.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.retreated.wiped: %s fell in the rank %s gate. It's open to anyone again.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.trespass.title: Trespassing
rival.beyondsolo.notify.trespass.body: %s holds this gate and you forced your way in: the Association took %s merit from you. Beat them to the boss and its reward is yours.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.race_lost.title: Race lost
rival.beyondsolo.notify.race_lost.body: %s dealt %s%% of the boss's damage and took its reward.
rival.beyondsolo.notify.race_won.title: Race won
rival.beyondsolo.notify.race_won.body: You beat %s to the boss: you dealt %s%% of its damage, and its reward is yours.
rival.beyondsolo.refuse.held: A rival party holds this gate and is clearing it. Crouch as you step in to force your way in (it costs merit).
rival.beyondsolo.talk.idle: Nothing on today. The Association will call when a gate opens.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.ask_leader: Ask %s, they're leading today. I just carry the spare blades.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.defer.0: A hunter of your rank? Take the gate if you want it. We won't argue.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.defer.1: Didn't think we'd see someone like you at a gate like this.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.defer.2: If you're going in, say so. Nobody here wants to get in your way.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.en_route.0: There's a gate this way. First party in gets the clear, so excuse us.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.en_route.1: The Association posted it an hour ago. We mean to be the first ones there.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.en_route.2: Heading for a gate. If you want it too, you'd better be quick.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.gathering.0: We go in once everyone's here. You're not thinking of slipping in first, are you?
rival.beyondsolo.talk.gathering.1: Checking our gear before we go in. A gate punishes the careless.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.gathering.2: Almost time. Stand back from the gate when we go.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.trespasser.0: You forced your way into a gate we hold? The Association will hear about this.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.trespasser.2: Claim jumper. Don't expect any help from us in here.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.race.0: Fine, it's a race. Whoever hits the boss hardest takes it.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.race.1: You won't beat us to the boss.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.inside.0: We hold this gate. Stay out of our way and we'll stay out of yours.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.inside.1: The boss is further in. We'll have it soon.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.inside.2: Watch your step. This gate is ours to clear.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.cleared.0: Gate's done. Better luck at the next one.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.cleared.1: A clean clear. The Association pays well for those.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.cleared.2: That boss never stood a chance.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.beaten.0: You got there first. Well played... this time.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.beaten.1: Next gate, we won't be so slow.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.beaten.2: The boss went to you. Fair's fair.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.stood_down.0: Someone beat us to it. On to the next one.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.stood_down.1: Not worth fighting over. We'll find another.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.stood_down.2: The gate was taken. A wasted trip.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.retreated.0: Too much for us. We pulled out while we still could.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.retreated.1: That boss was more than we bargained for.
rival.beyondsolo.talk.retreated.2: Never walk into a gate above your strength. We learned that today.
rival.beyondsolo.hire.outcome.unregister: Only hunters with a license can hire hands here.
rival.beyondsolo.hire.outcome.gone: That hand isn't available any more.
rival.beyondsolo.hire.outcome.hunters_fu: You can have at most %s hired hunters at once.
rival.beyondsolo.hire.outcome.rank: That hunter won't work for someone of a lower rank.
rival.beyondsolo.hire.outcome.porter: %s will carry your loot for %s minutes.
rival.beyondsolo.hire.outcome.hunter: %s will fight beside you for %s minutes.
rival.beyondsolo.hire.notify.end.title: Hired hand
rival.beyondsolo.hire.notify.end.time: %s's time is up: they head back to the office.
rival.beyondsolo.hire.notify.end.done: The gate is cleared, and %s's job is done.
rival.beyondsolo.hire.notify.end.fell_po: %s fell, and their pack lies where they fell.
rival.beyondsolo.hire.notify.handed: They handed over %s stacks of loot.
rival.beyondsolo.hud.gathering.line: %s · going in when the clock runs out
rival.beyondsolo.hud.trespass.line: %s holds this gate · beat them to the boss
rival.beyondsolo.hud.racing.line: %s · racing a hunter to the boss
rival.beyondsolo.hud.retreated.line: %s · pulled out, the gate is free
ui.beyondsolo.association.hire.title: HANDS FOR HIRE
ui.beyondsolo.association.hire.desc: Hunters between jobs sign on for %s minutes, paid up front: a porter carries what you pick up and hands it over when the job ends; a freelance hunter fights at your side. A gate you clear together ends the job.
ui.beyondsolo.association.hire.none: Nobody at this office is looking for work today. Come back tomorrow.
ui.beyondsolo.association.hire.record: Against rival parties: races won %s, lost %s · gates forced %s
ui.beyondsolo.association.hire.hint.hunt: You can hire at most %s hunters at once
ui.beyondsolo.association.hire.hint.rank: A rank %s hunter won't work for a hunter of lower rank
ui.beyondsolo.association.hire.hint.port: Hire %s to carry your loot for %s minutes, %s gold
ui.beyondsolo.association.hire.hint.hunt: Hire %s (%s, level %s) to fight beside you for %s minutes, %s gold
ui.beyondsolo.association.hire.hint.dism: Let %s go now: they hand over the pack first (no refund)
title.beyondsolo.gate_racer.desc: Beat a rival party to a gate's boss three times.
title.beyondsolo.claim_jumper.desc: Force your way into a gate a rival party holds, and take its boss from them.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.rival.send: Sends a rival party (a guild's, independents, or any; ranked: led by a hunter of the national rankings) for the nearest free gate, or a new gate if none is free.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.rival.arriv: The nearest party reaches its gate now.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.rival.enter: The nearest party goes into its gate now (first in, it holds the gate; after a hunter, it races them).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.rival.finis: The nearest party inside its gate clears it, or pulls out.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.rival.list: Every rival party: where it is and how it's doing.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.rival.forge: Forgets every rival party; their hunters go home.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.rival.recor: The player's races won and lost, and the gates they forced their way into.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.hire.porter: A porter of rank E or D for the players, for nothing, now.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.hire.hunter: A freelance hunter of that rank and class for the players, for nothing, now (their own rank if left out).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.hire.dismis: Lets every hired hand go (a porter hands over the pack).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.hire.list: The player's hired hands on the job.
command.beyondsolo.solo.rival.sent: %s set out for the rank %s gate at %s. They arrive in %s.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.no_ranked_: No ranked hunter of rank %s (%s) is free to lead a party.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.rival_gate: A rival party is already after that gate.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.no_rival_p: No rival party is on its way to a gate or inside one.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.rival_insi: That party is already inside its gate.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.rival_not_: That party isn't on its way to its gate any more.
That party isn't inside its gate.
command.beyondsolo.solo.error.hire_hunte: %s has as many hired hunters as allowed.
